changes.title: Temperate areas
items: The fern forest grows mossy birches, oaks and rowans among its ferns
Berried holly hedges run through the bluebell glade; red-berried shrubs grow in the hazel forest
The ancient wood has hollies for its cedars and a few old dead trees; the old pinewood has junipers for its larches

changes.title: Trunk streaks
items: Old oaks and other spreading trees keep their bark and branches below the leaves: no more flat stripes standing in for their trunks

changes.title: Ground lighter
items: The ground uses about 250 MB less graphics memory, every night and in the zoo, and looks the same
